digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store baseline persistence
propositions: Baseline storage for description, status, and priority can be normalized to scalar forms (normalized text and Jira name strings) without changing live comparison verdicts through the real inbound/outbound mapper seam.
Assignee field must preserve its complete vendor dict shape, all identity forms, and null absence state to maintain inbound-direction suppression and avoid overwriting concurrent remote edits.

A projection helper in inbound_fields.py applied at baseline write time produces idempotent normalization for already-scalar values and preserves field absence without requiring migration or comparator changes.
The pre-A3 reader accepts both vendor dict and scalar forms for description, status, and priority, enabling safe rollback via single Gerrit revert without lossy denormalization.

Full corpus comparison under current and separately-exported pre-A3 code must show zero forward mutation deltas, zero rollback mutation deltas, zero missing/errors, zero assignee value/shape deltas, and at least 50% serialized byte reduction.
